Description:
Bring vibrant elegance to your ethnic style with this multicolor glass bangle set beautifully adorned with shimmering stones. Featuring rich shades of green, blue, maroon, orange, and gold, these bangles are perfect for adding a pop of color to weddings, festivals, and special occasions.
Handcrafted with premium-quality glass and embellished with fine stone detailing, each bangle exudes traditional charm while offering a comfortable fit. The multicolor design makes this set a versatile accessory that pairs effortlessly with sarees, lehengas, salwar suits, and Indo-western outfits.
An excellent choice for bridal collections, festive gifting, and cultural celebrations, this bangle set is sure to become a timeless piece in your jewellery box.
Key Features:
-
Premium glass bangles with sparkling stones
-
Stunning multicolor design for versatile styling
-
Lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear
-
Ideal for weddings, festivals, and special events
-
Available in multiple sizes for a perfect fit
